findings.evidence: EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton/GPD/Kinematics.lean:171-183 and 200-297 against EpsilonEridani/Particles/Hadron/GravitationalFormFactors/Kinematics.lean:111-171. After this PR's own refactor of the GPD file the proofs coincide character for character: `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_delta_eq_zero` is `rw [avgMomentum_def, delta_def, map_smul, _root_.smul_apply, minkowskiProduct_add_sub_eq, K.minkowskiProduct_p_self_eq_minkowskiProduct_pPrime_self, sub_self, _root_.smul_zero]` in both (GPD line 267, new line 146), and `minkowskiProduct_p_delta_eq`/`minkowskiProduct_pPrime_delta_eq`/`minkowskiProduct_p_pPrime_eq` are the same one-line term proofs in both (GPD 285-297, new 139-171).
findings.fix: Introduce one base structure, e.g. `structure OnShellPair (d : ℕ) (M : ℝ)` carrying `p`, `pPrime` and the two mass-shell fields, and put `avgMomentum`, `delta`, `tMom`, `p_eq_avgMomentum_sub`, `pPrime_eq_avgMomentum_add` and the nine pairing identities on it once. Then `structure OffForwardKinematics (d) (M) extends OnShellPair d M` adds `n` and the two plus-momentum positivity fields, and `structure ElasticKinematics (T : Target) (d) extends OnShellPair d T.mass` adds `timeComponent_p_pos`/`timeComponent_pPrime_pos`; both namespaces inherit the fifteen declarations. If this must stay out of the present PR under the one-topic rule, ship the base structure as the prerequisite PR and rebase this one on it — the GPD file is already being edited here, so the refactor is not being avoided, only split.
findings.issue: Parallel API: `ElasticKinematics` restates fifteen `OffForwardKinematics` declarations verbatim (modulo `M` ↔ `T.mass`). New file / existing file line pairs: `avgMomentum` 111/171, `avgMomentum_def` 113/173, `delta` 116/176, `delta_def` 118/178, `tMom` 121/181, `tMom_def` 123/183, `p_eq_avgMomentum_sub` 125/200, `pPrime_eq_avgMomentum_add` 129/204, `minkowskiProduct_p_self_eq_minkowskiProduct_pPrime_self` 134/260, `minkowskiProduct_p_pPrime_eq` 139/285, `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_delta_eq_zero` 145/266, `minkowskiProduct_delta_avgMomentum_eq_zero` 151/272, `minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_self_eq` 156/277, `minkowskiProduct_p_delta_eq` 164/290, `minkowskiProduct_pPrime_delta_eq` 169/295. Both structures contain exactly the same four fields `p`, `pPrime`, `minkowskiProduct_p_self : ⟪p,p⟫ₘ = M^2`, `minkowskiProduct_pPrime_self : ⟪pPrime,pPrime⟫ₘ = M^2`; only the positivity hypothesis differs (positive plus-momentum along `n` vs positive energy).

summary: The new Minkowski-product helpers and the Breit-frame boost are genuinely new and correctly reuse Physlib/Mathlib, but `ElasticKinematics` duplicates fifteen declarations of `Particles.Parton.GPD.Kinematics.OffForwardKinematics` verbatim. Factor the common on-shell-pair data (p, p', two mass shells, P, Δ, t and their identities) into one base structure that both extend.
